2607.00917.title: Valdi: Value Diffusion World Models
2607.00917.paper_summary: World models can enable Model Predictive Control (MPC), but this requires dynamics prediction that is both fast enough for online use and expressive enough to represent uncertain futures. Diffusion models offer a natural mechanism for modeling uncertain dynamics, yet their iterative inference procedure makes them difficult to use for low-latency latent planning. We bridge this gap with Value Diffusion World Models (Valdi), combining end-to-end online training for MPC with a latent diffusion dynamics model. In preliminary experiments on the CarRacing environment, we show that Valdi, using a single diffusion step at both training and inference, matches a deterministic MLP baseline. Our experiments expose a trade-off between predictive multimodality and control performance in this setup. Code is available at https://github.com/Kit115/ValueDiffusionWorldModels.
2607.00917.paper_summary_zh: 世界模型可以實現模型預測控制（MPC），但這需要動態預測既要足夠快速以便於在線使用，又要足夠表達以代表不確定的未來。擴散模型提供了一種自然的機制來建模不確定的動態，但其迭代推理過程使得它們在低延遲潛在規劃中難以使用。我們通過價值擴散世界模型（Valdi）來彌補這一差距，將MPC的端到端在線訓練與潛在擴散動態模型相結合。在CarRacing環境的初步實驗中，我們顯示Valdi在訓練和推理中僅使用一步擴散，便能匹配確定性MLP基線。我們的實驗揭示了在這種設置中，預測多模態性與控制性能之間的權衡。代碼可在 https://github.com/Kit115/ValueDiffusionWorldModels 獲得。
